description: This file contains implementation of parsing functions for X.509 certificates, including parsing certificate structure, extensions, validity, and related components, with a focus on RFC 5280 compliance.

classes.name: ParsedDistributionPoint
classes.description: Structure representing parsed distribution point for CRL or OCSP.

classes.name: ParsedAuthorityKeyIdentifier
classes.description: Structure representing parsed Authority Key Identifier extension.

methods.name: VerifySerialNumber
methods.description: Validates the serial number of a certificate according to RFC 5280 rules.

methods.name: ReadUTCOrGeneralizedTime
methods.description: Reads a time value that can be either UTC or GeneralizedTime.

methods.name: ParseValidity
methods.description: Parses the validity period of a certificate.

methods.name: ParseCertificate
methods.description: Parses the main structure of an X.509 certificate.

methods.name: ParseTbsCertificate
methods.description: Parses the TBSCertificate part of an X.509 certificate.

methods.name: ParseExtensions
methods.description: Parses multiple extensions from a sequence.

methods.name: ConsumeExtension
methods.description: Consumes a specific extension from a set of unprocessed extensions.

methods.name: ParseAuthorityInfoAccess
methods.description: Parses the Authority Information Access extension.

methods.name: ParseAuthorityInfoAccessURIs
methods.description: Extracts URIs from Authority Information Access extension.
